text:
Priya: mockup uploaded — error session timeline v2. grouping exceptions by root cause + new export modal. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/ErrorSession-v2 (screenshot attached). Thoughts? :eyes:
Alex: the condensed rows look good. quick q — are duplicate stack traces collapsed with a count or are we showing all instances?
Ravi: collapse by trace hash and show a sample expanded row. keep a small count pill that opens a mini-list on hover/click. e.g. code idea: 
```
group_by: root_hash
show_sample: true
```
Joanne: a11y nit — the count pill contrast is low, and the chevron expand control has no strong focus ring when tabbed. need visible focus and aria labels. :a11y:
Priya: noted. also product question — when users multi-select sessions, do we export the whole bundle or only filtered traces? current mock does whole bundle which some PMs found surprising.
Alex: prefer two clear actions: "Export selection" and "Export visible". rename "Download bundle" -> "Export traces (all)" or similar. too many users confuse "download" with a one-off file vs export pipeline.
DesignBot: automated check: count pill contrast ratio 3.2:1 (fails WCAG AA). suggested color token -> #003A66 on white to reach >=4.5:1. Also flag missing aria-expanded on chevrons.
Ravi: UX idea — sticky correlation-ID column so folks can copy ids while scrolling wide tables. makes cross-app debugging easier.
Joanne: keyboard flow: when a row is expanded the code block receives focus but the copy button is not reachable by keyboard immediately. recommend adding a visible "Copy trace ID" button earlier in DOM order and a skip link for screen readers.
Priya: for rollout proposal: ship grouping + export modal now, hide sticky correlation column behind feature flag so infra can optimize. I'll update Figma and add copy tweaks. @Alex can you file the a11y ticket with repro and attach contrast screenshots?
Alex: will file the ticket with steps + screenshots + failing color checks. ETA tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: mock uploaded to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/design-mocks/error-session-v2 — preview available.
Priya: thanks — assigning follow-ups: a11y ticket (Alex), export copy PR (Priya), feature-flag work (Ravi). I'll drop updated frames by EOD and ping again.
